## Summary
Sidekix 0.4.4 gives Buddy a little more life with optional, private on-screen chatter that respects pacing and can be turned off. It also refreshes the Radio and Window editors for faster station/scene selection and in-place renaming, while Notes gains smoother text entry.
## Changes
- **feat**: Add optional Buddy chatter with local history, varied species-aware messages, and pet replies. - **improve**: Refresh Radio and Window station/scene controls with direct selection and in-place renaming. - **improve**: Add a reusable console text field and smoother Notes text entry. - **test**: Add coverage for Buddy chatter pacing, persistence, and message variety.
## Commits
61fa6fb55be71110f508684e2bac1a1fe48a9b2c release: bump version to 0.4.4 including Buddy chatter and controls

## Summary
Sidekix 0.4.3 makes the daily instruments more dependable and easier to control. Notes now supports editing, task cleanup, completion filtering, and undo; Window has a dedicated hover play/pause control; and Radio more reliably follows station selections and starts only when it can actually play.
## Changes
- **improve**: Add task editing, deletion, completion filtering, clear-completed, and undo to Notes. - **fix**: Separate Window playback from opening its detail panel, with an explicit hover control. - **fix**: Improve Radio station switching and playback reconciliation after launch. - **improve**: Give Buddy species fixed identities and simplify the companion profile. - **test**: Expand Notes and Buddy behavior coverage.
## Commits
2953706e5f7c0d6c744ca28fc2c0a68b2ce3dc0b release: bump version to 0.4.3 including Notes and playback fixes
